description.text: Main Courses: organic chemistry, physical chemistry, Biochemistry, Microbiology and Immunology, Medicinal Chemistry, Pharmacology,Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmacognosy, Introduction to Clinical Medicine, Pharmacy Administration

duration.text: The Pharmacy at Zhengzhou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Scanned copy of the passport (photo page, the latest exit/entrance record visa page, two blank visa pages).Senior high school transcripts and graduation diploma (Students expecting to graduate should provide an official letter stating the expected graduation date, and submit the graduation diploma if admitted), which should be the original documents or certified copies in Chinese or English (Applicants from India should also provide the transcripts from 12th semester).For the applicants of English-taught programs, Chinese language proficiency is not required when they apply, but the applicants must have HSK level 4 or above before internship. Applicants whose native/official language is not English should submit the IELTS /TOFEL result or other certificate to certify their English level. The result should be above 85(New TOFEL) or 6.0(IELTS).Chinese Proficiency Certificate (HSK score report, for the applicants of Chinese-taught programs only).Physical Examination Form.For applicants whose age is under 18 and parents are not resident in China, their parents must formally entrust a foreigner or Chinese resident in China as the guardian of the applicants and provide relevant entrusted materials.For the current applicants in China, the following documents are also required to submit in addition to the ones mentioned above:(1) residence permit page;(2) transfer certificate/no objection certificate/graduation certificate;(3) transcripts from the previous school;(4) registration form of temporary residence for Visitors from Overseas;(5) foreigner Physical Examination Form.8. If the applicant was originally a Chinese citizen but later joined a foreign nationality, he/she must provide (1) a certificate of withdrawal of Chinese nationality; (2) a certificate of cancellation of Chinese household registration; (3) a certificate of joining a foreign nationality; and (4) a record of entry and exit from the country during the period from April 30, 2020 to April 30, 2024.9. For applicants who were born in a foreign country and have acquired foreign nationality, if both or one of the parents are Chinese citizens, the applicant must provide (1) the applicant's birth certificate; (2) proof of nationality of the applicant's parents (the Chinese citizen side); and (3) the applicant's entry and exit records between April 30, 2020 and April 30, 2024.10. Physical examination report 11. certificate of no crime.update time : March 11, 2025

requirements.text: 1. International Candidate should be a non-Chinese citizen, with the age between 18 and 25, healthy, with non-criminal record.2. International Candidate should have an educational background equal to or above high school graduation (or equivalent).3. English language requirements: for candidates from non-English spoken countries applying for EMI (English Mediated Instruction) programs, their minimum IELTS score should reach 6.0 or TOEFL score reach82 (IBT) (553 in written version or 217 in computer version), or equivalent.
